subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold this behavior into `openclaw models status --probe --all`, or make it part of staged model migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent user-facing command surface overlaps existing auth probes plus two open model diagnostics or migration feature requests, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface, with an optional all-fallback mode, that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make the broader configured-model health-check work own this behavior and keep `/models` as a discoverability wrapper or no separate command.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in staged model migration and avoid a standalone command until that broader workflow is scoped.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface, with an optional all-fallback mode, that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided the clearest product-scoping guidance and has verified history on model fallback and status-probe surfaces.
